description: This file provides utility functions for device size detection and responsive font sizing in a React Native project, including device dimension calculations, normalization, and size adjustments based on device characteristics.

methods.name: getDeviceSize
methods.description: Calculates the diagonal size of the device screen in inches, adjusted for iPad devices.

methods.name: getDpi
methods.description: Calculates dots per inch based on pixel density.

methods.name: correction
methods.description: Adjusts font size based on device size and pixel density, with special handling for tablets.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes font size based on device pixel density.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns an object with various font sizes scaled for the device.

methods.name: updateSize
methods.description: Updates the font sizes dynamically based on current device metrics.
